purpose: Session B Phase 1 rule-status registry. Machine-readable single source consumed by tools/annotate_contract.js (generates contract/openapi.candidate.v1.1-draft.json with x-* annotations only) and tests/contract-rule-annotations.test.js. Annotations are NON-WIRE metadata; stripping every x-* key yields exactly the baseline candidate openapi.candidate.v1.json.

status_vocabulary.CONFIRMED: 已登记书面裁定或已核实事实；方向不得违反；技术细节仍可能待冻结
status_vocabulary.PROPOSED: 契约候选中的设计建议，可被评审修改；未冻结
status_vocabulary.PENDING: 待维护人/决策人裁定的开放差异或未定参数
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED: 被未决 IQ / B5-B8 / P0 阻断；在阻断关闭前不得冻结、不得实现为正式行为

decision_basis.IQ-01_IQ-02_IQ-13: 14_phase0_authority_adjudication/DECISION_REGISTER.md s2.1-s2.3 (registered 2026-11-17, UNSIGNED, independent acceptance NOT done)
decision_basis.r1_to_r4: HANDOVER-CONFIRMED only; FREEZE_READINESS_REVIEW.md status remains REVISED_AWAITING_REVIEW; no in-repo approval record

rules.title: Cross-system product identity = MPN + Brand; unique key (mpn_norm, brand_norm)
rules.notes: Registered ruling 2026-11-17; unsigned; independent acceptance not done. CONFIRMED refers to the registered ruling direction only.

rules.title: document_id / prod-{document_id} must never be a product identity or appear in identity routes
rules.notes: Registered ruling 2026-11-17; unsigned; independent acceptance not done.

rules.title: Raw preservation: mpn_raw / brand_raw / normalizer_version always kept alongside normalized values
rules.notes: Registered ruling item 2026-11-17; unsigned; independent acceptance not done.

rules.title: Identity state machine enum CONFIRMED / PENDING_BRAND / PENDING_CONFLICT / INVALID
rules.notes: Direction partially covered by IQ-01 (missing brand -> pending; conflicts never auto-merged); full aggregation rules are candidate-level PROPOSED.

rules.title: MPN-NORM-v1 normalization rule set (9 steps: encoding, NFKC, zero-width, whitespace, uppercase, dash mapping, brand parity, empty handling, conflict)
rules.notes: B5: must be review-frozen with vectorized test evidence before freeze.

rules.title: product_business_key encoding: pbk1_ + full lowercase hex SHA-256 of length-prefixed canonical (UTF-8 byte lengths); normalizer_version NOT in hash; missing brand -> no key
rules.notes: Encoding change after freeze = breaking change.

rules.title: identity_scope inclusion in business key undecided
rules.notes: Explicitly left open by IQ-01 ruling; schema has DEVICE/BOARD/ONBOARD_DEVICE/UNKNOWN enum.

rules.title: Exact lookup requires brand: missing brand -> 422 PRODUCT_IDENTITY_INCOMPLETE (missing=[brand]); illegal input -> 400; never fake empty results
rules.notes: EX-17 note says 400 - conflict logged; MD + candidate + mock agree on 422.

rules.title: mpn_match=loose not enabled in v1 (IQ-20)
rules.notes: enum exists in contract but disabled by default.

rules.title: Unified response envelope {code, message, data, request_id, meta} for all 15 business ops (token endpoint excluded)
rules.notes: Final shape OPEN per candidate s7.3; option A adopted provisionally.

rules.title: Error envelope: data=null, meta carries error_key/retryable/degraded_allowed (+field/missing)
rules.notes: Mock places error details in data - disposition deferred to IQ-09 ruling.

rules.title: Error catalog: 20 error codes / error_key table with retry + degraded flags; 40901 reserved (not triggered by v1 read-only ops)
rules.notes: Code values survive envelope-shape choice per candidate s7.3; 409 reserved.

rules.title: Server-generated request_id format req_ + 26-char ULID alphabet
rules.notes: P1-2: client-echo semantics unresolved.

rules.title: Client X-Request-Id echo (8-64 chars [A-Za-z0-9_-]); response header and body request_id must match
rules.notes: Header param missing from OpenAPI; echo-vs-regenerate rule unresolved.

rules.title: Cursor pagination: limit default 50 / max 200; opaque cursor
rules.notes: Mock uses default 10 and parseable offset cursor (DIFF-MOCK-02/16).

rules.title: PageMeta {limit, next_cursor, has_more}; has_more vs next_cursor precedence undefined (P2-7)
rules.notes: Evidence envelope meta binding is P1-10.

rules.title: Resource versioning: updated_at, data_version, etag; categories add taxonomy_version; concurrency via data_version/ETag only
Conditional requests: If-None-Match -> 304 no body, not an error
rules.notes: Mock does not implement 304 (DIFF-MOCK-03).

rules.title: sort=field:asc|desc whitelist (updated_at, sort_order, level, category_code) - MD only, absent from OpenAPI
rules.notes: Add param or declare v1 no sort.

rules.title: Rate limits: 60 rpm/client burst 20; tree 10 rpm; search 30 rpm; 429 + Retry-After
rules.notes: Numbers PROPOSED per IQ-12.

rules.title: Deprecation: Deprecation header + Sunset, >=90 days notice; v1 additive-only, breaking -> /api/v2, v1 kept >=180 days
OAuth2 Client Credentials; opaque Bearer token (256-bit base64url); client_secret_basic
rules.notes: Local/staging credential policy is IQ-21.

rules.title: Token params: expires_in 900s, refresh at <=120s remaining, 60s clock skew, no refresh token
rules.notes: expires_in const 900 in machine contract vs IQ-12 PROPOSED (P1-8).

rules.title: Revocation propagation: all resource servers must reject from 60s after revocation
Revocation mechanism choice: RFC 7009 endpoint OR admin-side disable
rules.notes: Not a missing required endpoint (R3 correction).

rules.title: Five scopes; missing scope -> 403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE, no downgrade; internal_only needs product.category.read + product.publish.read; sync minimal set = first four scopes
rules.notes: Mock implements no scope checks (DIFF-MOCK-04).

rules.title: Non-production credential allowance (local/staging) undecided
rules.notes: Blocks local/staging integration design and security audit plan.

rules.title: Production client registration, secret storage and rotation owner undecided
rules.notes: Phase 4 blocker.

rules.title: Three-gate order fixed: pipeline -> content -> release; upstream not passed => downstream must not be marked approved
rules.notes: Gates PROPOSED, not implemented anywhere.

rules.title: Gate state enums: pipeline PENDING/PASS/FAILED; content PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED; release PENDING/APPROVED/REVOKED - three namespaces must not be merged
rules.notes: PIPELINE_PASS != CONTENT_APPROVED != RELEASE_APPROVED; naming reconciliation owed by design doc maintainer.

rules.title: visible_state derived enum DRAFT/IN_REVIEW/RELEASED/WITHDRAWN + derivation rule
rules.notes: Mock uses RELEASED/PENDING/REVOKED labels (DIFF-MOCK-06) - demo simplification, not contract enum.

rules.title: release_state query filter enum RELEASED/REVOKED/PENDING (distinct namespace from gates and visible_state)
rules.notes: Same B6 reconciliation.

rules.title: Search defaults: release_state=RELEASED and identity_state=CONFIRMED; pending identities are not synced as products
rules.notes: Mock default does not filter (DIFF-MOCK-05); item shape itself is DIFF-CONTRACT-01.

rules.title: Consumer behavior contract: 403 not-released -> no retry keep local; 410 revoked -> terminal, stop public display and caches; REVOKED stream V1_REQUIRED; 304 treated as success
Technical parameter taxonomy owned by Ds Bit; business navigation taxonomy owned by Morrishk; two ID spaces never shared; navigation categories not exposed via this API

rules.title: Endpoint inventory: 12 required unique paths + token = 13 required ops + 3 optional = 16 ops; classification matrix verified consistent (R1)

rules.title: Single taxonomy_id assumption in CategoryEdges (single-value required field) vs undecided taxonomy count

rules.title: Category lifecycle: DRAFT/REVIEWED/PUBLISHED/DEPRECATED; DEPRECATED readable during retention with merged_into/split_into; retention end -> 410 CATEGORY_RETIRED

Change record event enum (9 events) on optional /changes endpoint
